nodes.label: PosNormUV.vert (main vertex shader)
nodes.rationale: Named after the vertex format it consumes (position, normal, UV); transforms to clip space, emits world position, transformed normal and UV for interpolation.

nodes.label: nMat = inverse(transpose(mMat)) for normals
nodes.rationale: Normals cannot ride the world matrix: under a non-uniform scale mMat tilts them off the surface, and the scene really does have a non-uniformly scaled instance. Passed as a mat4 and truncated in the shader because a std140 mat3 is three separately 16-byte-aligned columns, easy to get subtly wrong from C++.
